mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (order_id, user_id, rating, content, images) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nickname as user_nickname FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT r.*, u.nickname as user_nickname FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT r.*, u.nickname as user_nickname FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT r.*, u.nickname as user_nickname FROM review r LEFT JOIN `order` o ON r.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE o.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
